extDescription.message: Connect to local Anda in your browser: an agent that uses browser and command-line tools, Skills, long reasoning, and graph memory.

localFileAccessDisabled.message: Enable "Allow access to file URLs" for the Anda Bot extension in the browser extension details, then retry.

onboardingIntro.message: The browser extension needs Anda Desktop (or the anda command line), a configured model provider, and a running local daemon before chat is available.

onboardingInstallBody.message: Download Anda Desktop for Windows or Mac. It installs the anda command line and a tray that keeps the local daemon available. On Linux, or for the command line only, use the install script.

onboardingConfigureBody.message: Open Anda from the system tray, menu bar, or Start Menu, add your provider, API key and model in Settings → Agent configuration, and keep Anda running while you use the extension.

configEditorBody.message: Use the dedicated page for model providers, voice, transcription, channels, users, and other daemon options.

onboardingTokenBody.message: Copy the printed Gateway URL and Bearer token into the fields below. Anda Desktop can also copy a token from its tray.

tokenPlaceholder.message: Paste the Bearer token printed by `anda browser token --days 365`

promptCommandNewDescription.message: Start a fresh conversation with an optional first prompt.

promptCommandLoopDescription.message: Run a prompt or slash command repeatedly. Describe an interval in your own words, or omit it to let the model self-pace.

promptCommandSideDescription.message: Run a temporary side request in a subagent.

promptCommandSteerDescription.message: Redirect the next model step with a new instruction.

promptCommandSkillDescription.message: Route the prompt to a named skill subagent.

promptCommandStopDescription.message: Stop the current task and keep the conversation idle.

promptCommandCancelDescription.message: Cancel the active conversation session with an optional reason.

approvalModeOnRiskDescription.message: Ask only for operations that look risky

actionChoiceAutoSelect.message: Picks “$1” in $2 if you don’t answer

actionDenyWithReply.message: No, and say what to do instead

shellApprovalMessage.message: The agent wants to run a local shell command.

sendWithEnter.message: Enter to send. Shift + Enter for a new line.

sendWithCmdEnter.message: Command + Enter to send. Enter for a new line.

sendWithCtrlEnter.message: Control + Enter to send. Enter for a new line.

pasteTokenFirst.message: Complete setup and paste a bearer token generated by `anda browser token` first.

configModelsDescription.message: Choose the active model and maintain every provider entry available to the daemon.

configProvidersDescription.message: Labels route memory, flash, image, audio, and video requests.

configTtsDescription.message: Enable speech synthesis and configure any provider block you want saved under tts.

configTranscriptionDescription.message: Configure voice transcription defaults and provider-specific options.

configChannelsDescription.message: Configure Telegram, WeChat, Discord, and Lark/Feishu runtimes. Replies stay routed by each platform route.

configUsersDescription.message: Trusted users that can share this daemon and the same Anda agent.

configSaved.message: Saved config.yaml. Restart Anda for daemon startup settings to take effect.

bookmarksNoMatches.message: No loaded bookmarks match this search.

bookmarksLibrarySubtitle.message: Browse saved messages, organize folders, and reopen chat context.

bookmarkContextSubtitle.message: The selected bookmark's message, source, and folders.

bookmarkNotLocated.message: Could not locate the message; its conversation may be unavailable.

skillOptimizationPromptReady.message: Optimization prompt filled in the side panel.

skillDeleteConfirm.message: Move this Personal skill to trash?

skillInlineTools.message: Runs in the conversation and uses the agent's own tools

skillOptimizeAndaHint.message: Anda will receive this directory path and use skill-creator to inspect and update the skill.

skillOptimizePersonalOnly.message: Only Personal skills can be optimized. Copy this skill to Personal first.

brainInboxHint.message: Read and answer your durable memory tasks. Answers are data, not permission to act.

brainInboxEmpty.message: No visible items on this page.

brainResponsePending.message: Response awaiting confirmation. Retrying keeps the same event and text.

brainPageCompleteHint.message: The end of a page does not mean its tasks are complete.

memoryIntro.message: Useful preferences and project context can carry into your next conversation. Everyday memory needs no extra setup.

memoryExample.message: Remember: I prefer concise release notes with a short risk section.

memoryTryHint.message: Paste this into a conversation. After background processing, use /new and ask about the preference without repeating the answer.

memoryEvidenceHint.message: A completed conversation was processed; this does not prove that every fact was saved.

memoryNoActivity.message: No processing records are visible yet.

memoryPartial.message: The activity index is still incomplete.

memoryPrivacyHint.message: Memory is local by default. Your configured model providers may process its content and charge for it. These status checks do not invoke a model.

memoryConnectionHelp.message: Check the connection and owner token. Older servers may not support this memory view.

memoryNoRecords.message: No verifiable memory records are available yet.

memoryChangeConfirmed.message: The change is complete. Start a new conversation to use the updated memory.

memoryChangeScope.message: Only the listed claims, cited messages and recorded dependents are changed. Working notes are reset and old source conversations stop contributing memory. Chat, files, logs, backups, other independent records and already-delivered context remain.

memoryChangePending.message: The accepted change is still being processed.

memoryReviewHint.message: Review the exact scope before confirming. Preparing this preview does not change the memory graph.

memoryUnknownHint.message: The result is unknown. Check the original operation; do not send a new change.

memoryReviseKind.message: What kind of change is this?

memoryKindHint_correct.message: My earlier statement was wrong. The new value replaces it for the same time.

memoryKindHint_world_change.message: It was true then. From now on it is different.

memoryKindHint_misrecorded.message: I never said this. Brain re-reads the original message and repairs the record.

memoryChangeFailed.message: The change could not be completed. Review the record and try again.

memoryErasure_completed.message: Erasure verified on every covered surface.

memoryErasure_partial.message: Erasure finished, but some surfaces could not be verified.

memoryErasure_blocked.message: Erasure is blocked by a legal hold.

memoryDraftStored.message: The draft is saved on this device. Closing this window does not confirm or cancel a change.

memoryDraftNotCreated.message: No preview exists on the server. Review this saved request again or discard it.

memoryChangeDiscarded.message: The draft was discarded or expired.

memorySetupScope.message: Keep questions about changed memories across conversations. This adds a private owner inbox only. Subscribing later grants the controller permission to cancel that specific subscription. No learning or execution authority is enabled.

memorySetupPreview.message: Review this configuration change. A private backup is kept. Nothing takes effect until you restart Anda.

memorySetupRestart.message: Configuration saved. Finish your current tasks, then run the command below. Return here afterward to check access.

memorySearchPlaceholder.message: What did I say about release notes?

memorySearchCost.message: Search may call a model. Default limits: 4,096 packet tokens and 32,768 planner input tokens; these are not a total cost cap.

memorySearchUnknown.message: No automatic retry. Starting another search may incur another charge.

memorySearchPacket.message: Retrieved context includes coverage and warnings. It is not proof that a fact is saved or permission to act.

memoryCopyPacket.message: Copy context with sources and warnings

memoryWatch.message: Ask me when this memory changes

memoryWatching.message: Watching this record. Questions will appear in the memory inbox.

memorySuppressScope.message: The previewed claims, cited inputs and recorded dependents are retained but archived. Their source conversations stop contributing new memory. Processing Notes and history context are reset. Chat, files, backups and already delivered context remain.

memoryUndoPreview.message: Preview a new correction to undo

memorySourceTruncated.message: This quote is shortened. Open the original for the complete message.

memoryLearningScope.message: Business learning supports the precondition workflow template only. It requires separate executor, observer and task source, reviewed calibration, deployment approval and native rollback. Ordinary memory does not need it.

memoryLearning_not_compiled.message: This build does not include business learning.

memoryLearning_services_missing.message: The required business services are not installed.

memoryLearning_identity_mismatch.message: Service identities or pinned contracts do not match.

memoryLearning_calibration_missing.message: Review calibration for this task family first.

memoryLearning_awaiting_approval.message: Configured; awaiting explicit automation and deployment approval.

memoryLearning_ready.message: Isolated learning is ready. Business application still needs separate approval; native authority and services are rechecked for each work item.

memoryLearning_unavailable.message: Readiness could not be checked. Restore the runtime connection and access first.

memoryEvaluationCli.message: Isolated memory comparison is available from the CLI in builds with MIB. Create a plan before explicitly running it. Model costs may be incomplete.

memorySearchFee.message: Search may call a model and incur a charge. It never retries automatically.

memoryPageSizeLimit.message: More records are available on the next page.

memoryChangeNeedsReview.message: The change could not be applied. Discard this preview and review a fresh one.

voiceInputUnavailable.message: Voice input is unavailable in this browser.

configConnectionChanged.message: Connection settings changed. Reload the configuration before saving.

memoryEntityGraphHint.message: Shows only the entities in the memories listed on this page. Select one to open it.

memoryEntityIntro.message: Memories you can review that involve this entity, grouped by relation, newest first.

memoryEntityShown.message: $1 memories on this page, $2 of them current.

memoryEntitySelfEmpty.message: There are no memories about you to review yet.

memoryEntityNotFound.message: There are no memories about this that you can review.

memoryEntityScanLimit.message: Some memories about this entity are not shown yet. Load the next page to continue.

memoryBeliefHint.message: Brain weighs every statement about the same fact with its standard recall policy: more specific context first, a person's own statements over hearsay, then the most recent. A statement replaced by a newer one stays as history. Imported memory, such as memory upgraded from KIP 1, is shown but not counted in the current belief.

memoryBelief_excluded.message: Not counted in the current belief

memoryEntitySearchLabel.message: Find a person, project or topic

memoryEntitySearchHint.message: Matches names without calling a model. Only entities with a memory you can review are listed.

memoryEntitySearchEmpty.message: No entity with a memory you can review matched.

memorySourceUnrecorded.message: No verifiable source: memory from before the upgrade, or a conclusion Brain drew itself. You can view it but not correct it here.

chatgptDescription.message: Connect your ChatGPT account to use eligible models with your plan. Audio and video require a separate provider.

chatgptConnectedNotice.message: ChatGPT is connected. Select a model to start using your plan.

chatgptPermissionDisabled.message: Signed in, but permission to use the ChatGPT plan is disabled. Reconnect to enable it.

chatgptRevocationUnconfirmed.message: Signed out locally. Remote revocation was not confirmed; disconnect Anda Bot in ChatGPT settings.

chatgptSaveConfigFirst.message: Save or reload your configuration changes before switching to a ChatGPT model.

chatgptUpdateDesktop.message: Update Anda Desktop to connect ChatGPT.

chatgptUpdateDaemon.message: Update the Anda daemon to connect ChatGPT.

mcpEmptyDetail.message: Add an MCP server to give Anda new tools: paste a configuration from another app, a remote URL, or a local command.

mcpNotConnected.message: Connect to the Anda daemon to manage MCP servers.

mcpSourceRuntime.message: This session of the daemon only

mcpSignInWaiting.message: Finish signing in to $1 in your browser. This page updates when it is done.

mcpRemoveConfirm.message: This removes the server from mcp.json, with its stored sign-in and the secrets that only it uses.

mcpApprovalNotice.message: MCP tools now ask before they run, unless they are read-only and unchanged since you reviewed them, or the chat has full access. To let a server's tools run without asking, open its Tools tab and choose Always allow.

mcpChangedOnDisk.message: mcp.json was changed outside Anda. Apply it before making changes here.

mcpApprovalAutoDetail.message: Asks unless the tool is read-only and reviewed, or the chat has full access.

mcpApprovalAskDetail.message: Asks before every call, even with full access.

mcpApprovalAllowDetail.message: Runs without asking while the tool is unchanged since review.

mcpApprovalHelp.message: A tool's own setting wins over the server default. A tool that changed since you reviewed it asks again.

mcpToolsWhenConnected.message: The tools appear once the server is connected.

mcpRuntimeReadOnly.message: This server was added for the running daemon only, so its settings cannot be saved. Add it to mcp.json to keep them.

mcpOAuthNeeded.message: This server needs you to sign in.

mcpAuthHeaders.message: Signs in with the headers in its configuration.

mcpNoServerSecrets.message: This server uses no stored secrets.

mcpExternalUsers.message: Let external IM users use this server

mcpExternalUsersHelp.message: Runs for people you chat with on IM channels may call its tools that need no approval. They can never approve a call for you.

mcpConfigHelp.message: The server's entry in $1, with secrets hidden. Edit the file by hand, then apply it.

mcpSecretsHelp.message: Secrets keep tokens out of mcp.json: reference one as ${secret:NAME} in a header, env value, or URL. Values are stored on this computer and are never shown again.

mcpAddDescription.message: Anda tests the server before you add it. A local command runs on this computer: check it first.

mcpHeaders.message: Headers, one Name: value per line

mcpStoreAsSecretsHelp.message: Header values, tokens and keys go to the secret store, and mcp.json keeps only a reference.

mcpJsonNoServers.message: No servers found. Paste an mcpServers object, or a single entry with a command or url.

mcpLocalWarning.message: This command will run on this computer.

mcpAddByHandDetail.message: A remote URL, a local command, or pasted JSON

mcpFromLink.message: This server came from a link. Check what it connects to or runs before you test or add it.

mcpImportMenuDetail.message: Claude, Cursor, VS Code, Windsurf and Codex

mcpImportDescription.message: MCP servers set up in other apps on this computer. Their files are only read, never changed.

mcpImportNone.message: No MCP settings from other apps were found on this computer.

mcpImportSecretLater.message: Set it now, or later under Secrets

mcpImportIsolated.message: Imported local servers get only the essentials of the daemon's environment and their own env.

mcpRegistryMenuDetail.message: Servers published to the official registry

mcpRegistryDescription.message: Servers published to the official MCP Registry.

mcpRegistryTrust.message: The Registry shows that a server was published, not that it is safe. Check who publishes it before you install it. Its tools ask before they run until you allow them.

mcpRegistryUnsupportedSse.message: It uses the SSE transport, which Anda does not support.

mcpRegistryUnsupportedTransport.message: It runs as a local web server, which Anda cannot start.

mcpRegistryUnsupportedPackage.message: Anda cannot run this kind of package. Install it yourself, then add its command.

mcpRegistryNothing.message: Anda cannot run this server in any of the ways it is published.

mcpOptionsHelp.message: Saved in this server's mcp.json entry. A change that affects the connection reconnects the server.

mcpOptionsUnavailable.message: Fix this server's entry in mcp.json to change its advanced settings.

mcpOptionEnvIsolate.message: Only the essentials and its own env

mcpOptionsNumbers.message: Use whole numbers, or leave a field empty for its default.

mcpEventsHelp.message: Events this server can report. An automation runs the agent on your instructions when one arrives; its replies appear in a conversation of yours.

mcpEventsError.message: The events could not be listed: $1

mcpEventsUnsupported.message: This server does not report events (MCP Events).

mcpEventsWebhookOnly.message: Only a webhook delivers this event; $1 (dMsg) receives it.

mcpEventsNoIngress.message: Only a webhook delivers this event. To receive it, add dMsg to mcp.json with "events": {"webhook_ingress": true}.

mcpTriggersNone.message: No automations run on this server's events yet.

mcpTriggerDeleteConfirm.message: The automation stops for good, and the events waiting for it are dropped. Its past runs stay in their conversation.

mcpTriggerArgumentsJson.message: The arguments, as a JSON object.

mcpTriggerArgumentsJsonInvalid.message: The arguments must be a JSON object.

mcpTriggerInstructionsPlaceholder.message: What should the agent do with these events? For example: classify each new issue and add a label.

mcpTriggerBatchWindowHelp.message: Events arriving within this time are handled in one run.

mcpTriggerUnattended.message: Automations run on their own, and event data comes from the server, so it is untrusted. These runs can use read-only tools and tools set to Always allow; anything that needs your approval is refused.
